mechanism: Both are beta-lactam antibiotics with potential for additive antimicrobial effects and rare cross-reactivity in penicillin-allergic patients; ceftazidime has ~1-3% cross-reactivity with penicillins.
action: Avoid concurrent use in penicillin-allergic patients; if both required, use with caution and monitor for hypersensitivity reactions; generally safe in non-allergic patients for synergistic coverage.
